settings.model_objective: Maximum historical arithmetic mean return within the position cap and estimated volatility ceiling.
settings.evidence_floor_policy: At least one declared year of later test returns. This descriptive minimum does not measure statistical significance.
settings.execution: Prior-close information; execute at the following close; first interval in zero-interest cash.
settings.cost_convention: Basis points per absolute dollar bought or sold; cash transfers excluded; no final liquidation.
settings.risk_constraint: Annual estimated stock volatility ceiling; realized volatility can exceed the target.
settings.baseline: Buy equal weights across initially eligible stocks once, without a volatility constraint, then let weights drift.
settings.comparisons: Equal-weight stocks and raw SPY/QQQ buy-and-hold funds. Each uses the same initial delay and trading costs.
settings.screen: Exclude stocks with at least 20 consecutive unchanged price intervals in past fit data only.
settings.test_role: Later buy-and-hold replay of the initial past-data fit, without rebalancing. The researcher can already know these dates.
